decisions.reason: Although prior launch effort creates some commitment, the coffee-based men's line appears more peripheral to the firm's narrow core assortment and less visibly tied to an announced strategic direction, so management is comparatively readier to withdraw it.

As a close extension of the established Sandorini skincare line, the cleansing foam benefits from sunk development, public launch commitment, and an easy temporary-factors justification, which makes management inclined to continue it.
